tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open Day 4 — Sabalenka routs Iatcenko 6-1 6-1; Alcaraz survives scare vs Faria; Pegula and Medvedev cruise; Shelton edges Hurkacz in four sets • [SQUASH] London Classic Round 2 Day 2 at Alexandra Palace — Coll faces Todd; eight more last-16 matches set quarter-finalists • [BADMINTON] China Masters Round of 16 in Shenzhen — Naraoka tops Li Shifeng; world champs Gicquel-Delrue out; wide open draw after two days of shocks • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Nationals Round of 16 in Cary — PPA Major worth 2,000 ranking points; Tennis Channel coverage from 11:30am ET • [TABLE TENNIS] ETTU Champions League Stage 2 underway — Saarbrücken vs Lille Metropole; Ljubljana European Individuals accreditations open until Sept 28

newsItems.title: Sabalenka and Alcaraz Reach US Open Third Round
newsItems.excerpt: Defending champion Aryna Sabalenka routed Polina Iatcenko 6-1, 6-1 while Carlos Alcaraz survived a first-set scare to beat Jaime Faria — Jessica Pegula, Daniil Medvedev and Ben Shelton also advanced on Day 4.

newsItems.title: London Classic Round 2 Continues at Ally Pally
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Gold London Squash Classic moves through Round 2 Day 2 at Alexandra Palace — defending champion Paul Coll faces Sam Todd while Jasmine Hutton and Anahat Singh carry home-nation hopes into the last 16.

newsItems.title: China Masters Round of 16 Underway
newsItems.excerpt: The Super 750 tournament in Shenzhen enters the last 16 after two days of shocks — Kodai Naraoka beat Li Shifeng and newly crowned mixed doubles world champions Gicquel-Delrue fell in the opening round.

newsItems.title: ETTU Stage 2 and Ljubljana Preview
newsItems.excerpt: HYLO Champions League Stage 2 matchups are set with Saarbrücken facing Lille Metropole — media accreditation also opened for the European Individual Championships in Ljubljana, running October 11–18.
